args.name: Restorative sleep
args.function: Sleep safely at my current location when conditions permit, with an actual trial of whether sleep restores physical energy.
args.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary soil at night, with no observed local hazards and other people nearby. My energy is 33.244 out of 40. My experience records 32 rounds of rest and zero recovered energy; I do not know why resting has not restored energy.
args.inputs: My own time and body; any required bedding or shelter must be identified rather than assumed available.
args.costs: Unknown; specify a feasible duration, prerequisites, and any exposure or interruption risks.
args.effects: Provide a feasible sleep method with observable recovery if physically supported, or explain unmet conditions. Do not assume recovery merely from requesting or learning it.

candidates.function: Draw a simple picture of something you see now by tracing short grooves with a finger in nearby soil, after a one-groove test of whether that patch keeps them.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. test: surfaceRef ground (the only drawable surface) at x, y, a point at most 0.5 from you that you see now, not water, a body or any object; extent, the square patch side, 0.05-0.3 (default 0.3); method finger-groove (implement-groove and material-mark are refused as unavailable, naming what is missing); optional subjectRef. One round, 0.5 energy: one short test groove, which stays even if the soil fails. draw: subjectRef, an object you see now; strokes, 1-6, each 2-8 points as x, y offsets inside the patch, each at most extent long; two rounds, 0.5 energy each (one round for a single stroke), half the strokes per round, continuing; draw again resumes a pause. cancel: one round, no energy. All need light. Checks run before any charge.
candidates.effects: Forest floor and meadow ground (fine, yielding soil) keep a finger groove 0.02 wide and 0.01 deep unless waterlogged; rocky ground, a wet bank or waterlogged soil does not, and the test says why. No pigment or item is used: soil is pushed to the groove edges. A groove shows by its shaded floor: the ground tone darkened by 1 - 1/sqrt(1 + (2 depth / width)^2); contrast is the 0-1 colour distance, visible from 0.05. The grooves form one ground drawing nearby people see, with geometry, depth, colour, contrast, subject, strokes and status. Only performed strokes are recorded; completion means they were made, not that they look like the subject. Losing sight of the subject, reach, light or an unchanged patch pauses at no charge, as does an unworked round. No rain, trampling or erosion rule acts on ground marks here, so durability is untested. Nothing is refunded; no reward.

candidates.function: Inspect whole units of your own shelled food, such as hazelnuts, for visible defects, or shell a batch one unit at a time: press each on a clean hard support with your own blunt implement (or by hand where that works), then separate kernel and shell. Kernels are unverified, not certified food.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. inspect: targetStack (your own unreserved, untreated item of a material with represented shell and kernel) and quantity (whole units, 1-5, default 1); one round, 0.2 energy per unit. shell: targetStack and quantity reserve that batch in a work record (workId); each unit then takes a press round and a separation round, 0.5 energy each; a press that only cracks the shell adds a round. Press with implementRef (your own whole, hard, sound inedible piece) on supportRef (a solid unreserved inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, with no loose item on it, or another such own piece on firm ground where you stand), or by hand with neither. shell continues round by round until the batch is done; shell again (or with workId) resumes a pause. cancel: one round, no energy. All need light. Checks run before any charge; a failed recheck pauses open work at no charge.
candidates.effects: Inspection records ripeness, shell state, deterioration and spoilage by eye (mould and infestation are not represented); spoiled or visibly deteriorated units are set aside as a rejected item and not shelled. Strength is hardness / 10; a press passes the lower of implement and support strength x (1 - flexibility), a bare hand 0.1 / unit mass^(2/3). At or below the shell strength the shell holds: an unmet-prerequisite result that pauses the work, and that method is refused for it. Above it damage (load - strength) / strength accumulates: below 1 cracked, at 1 split open. Separation makes a kernel item and a shell item whose quantities are their mass shares and sum to the unit; the kernel carries all of its food value and toxicity, origin, age and decay, is inspected by eye and is an unverified shelled specimen or a rejected item, never certified food; a 0.4 item is less than the whole unit eat takes. Nothing is washed, heated or made safe. Unworked rounds pause; cancel returns reserved units as they now are; death drops them. Nothing is refunded; no reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"ivo\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The searched catalogue and exact rest contract establish an existing recovery operation, but no sleep operation. rest (base:rest:1, foundation-forest@1, handler forest.rest) restores base 4 energy per completed round, subject to actual facility modifiers and the cap of 40; it does not establish sleeping, exposure checks or waking. Develop the missing general sleep process, reusing that recovery implementation rather than inventing a second energy source. The reported 32 rest rounds with zero recovery conflict with the advertised effect and warrant an execution/accounting check in the current-conversation development handoff, not an assumed diagnosis or retroactive energy award.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: sleep at the actor's current location, with start, continue, wake/cancel and status modes; requested duration is a positive whole number of simulation rounds, default 1 for the smallest trial. This is a bounded sleep trial, not a claim that one round equals a full night's sleep. Dependencies: the existing world clock, action/work records, local environmental checks, bodily-state rules, and forest.rest recovery/accounting. Record exact reused code references and any correction in the implementation record. Development/review waiting advances no time. Before enabling execution, inspect the existing rest handler and its real call path, blockers and vital-update ordering; fix a demonstrated implementation defect in the shared recovery path rather than adding a sleep-only bypass. If the substrate cannot represent sleeping or assess required environmental conditions, implement those minimal mechanisms in this handoff; do not display a successful sleep trial until they execute.\\nPrerequisites: living actor physically able to lie down and enter sleep; reachable unoccupied supporting ground at the actual current position; environmental suitability established from currently available local observations and represented exposure rules. Ordinary soil at night and no observed hazard are not proof of safety. Read temperature semantics before applying any thermal check: the supplied temperature 24.24049679 must not be presumed to be ambient temperature. No bedding, shelter, watcher or other participant is supplied. Bare-ground sleep is permitted only if actual support and exposure checks allow it. If not, report the specific unmet condition and the required physical property of bedding/shelter, not an invented available object. A nearby person provides no protection unless that person independently communicates and performs a supported action.\\nCosts and conservation: each completed sleeping interval costs one simulation round and occupies the actor's body, location and action channel; no simultaneous active work. No item consumption, new stock or arbitrary energy fee is introduced. Existing hunger, metabolic, exposure and other ongoing processes continue under their established rules, once per elapsed round. The owned root stack item-7-ivo-76 is neither consumed nor converted into bedding or energy by this operation. Invoke the shared recovery path at most once per completed eligible interval; apply its actual modifiers and cap, with no double recovery from a concurrent rest action. Track any bodily/material inputs required by the implemented metabolism and refuse unsupported energy creation. At the supplied energy 33.24426694, an unmodified successful rest-equivalent interval would yield 37.24426694 before other actual debits; this is a conditional prediction, not an awarded outcome. There are no invented facility bonuses.\\nExecution and evidence: record work ID, actor reference, current position/support reference, duration, completed intervals, awake/entering/asleep/paused/woken status, suitability results and timestamps. For each trial record pre-energy, recovery eligibility, actual recovery credit, other energy debits, post-energy and applicable caps/modifiers. A verified net-zero result must distinguish a blocked recovery, an offsetting cost and an unresolved accounting fault where evidence permits; do not infer a cause from the request. Entry and sleep require actual runtime events. Check suitability on entry and every interval; wake or pause on a detected threat, unsafe exposure, lost support, incompatible action, injury or explicit wake command as supported by the engine. Do not guarantee detection of unseen threats. No unattended full-duration advance or others' actions may be assumed.\\nProgress and lifecycle: only completed eligible intervals earn their actual recovery. Interruption retains completed interval history and the recorded reason, but grants no unearned partial-interval recovery. Resume requires fresh suitability checks and another actual sleep entry. Cancellation wakes the actor and ends pending work without undoing elapsed time, metabolic costs or recovery already received. Death terminates sleep immediately and invokes ordinary death/inventory rules; no post-death recovery. No escrow or material reservation is needed for bare-ground sleep, so no item refund is due. If later implementations reserve real bedding, release surviving reservations on cancellation or death without repairing wear or refunding consumed resources. Continue environmental checks and normal ongoing processes while asleep; there is no persistent protective field or maintenance-free shelter. Real outputs are completed sleep intervals, measured vital changes and retained trial observations, or an explicit blocked/interrupted outcome. Rules execute in code after implementation, not by repeated model approval.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Learning, requesting, status queries and naming yield no pleasure or satisfaction. Energy recovery is a functional effect, not an automatic mood award. A completed, personally applicable trial may supply verified information, including an informative failure; deduplicate it against equivalent rest/sleep findings and require an actual observation record. No new reward rule or amount is created here: use an existing applicable bounded event-based experience rule with its cap, decay and cooldown, otherwise award zero. Familiar genuinely comfortable sleep may support modest maintained benefit only under such an implemented rule; physical comfort remains capped at 10. Basic nutrition is not reduced by mood. Do not modify protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use reusable sleep-process metadata tied to the real actor and work ID: position/support reference, posture, phase, completed intervals, interruption reason and event timestamps. Show a lying/asleep state only after actual entry, never on request, learning or a failed check. Emit sleep-entered, interval-completed, recovery-measured, interrupted and woken events as applicable. Recovery visuals must reflect the recorded actual energy delta, not the predicted base 4; distinguish recovery credit from net change. Blocked or zero-recovery trials show that result and available evidence, never a success badge, restored-energy glow or invented shelter/watchers. Visuals themselves confer no functional or experience benefit.\"}]}"}
